checks.title: Endpoint rejects requests with no credentials
Endpoint rejects expired/invalid tokens
No credentials or secrets exposed in URLs, logs, or error messages
Password/credential reset flow cannot be abused for account takeover
Requesting another user's object ID returns 403/404, not the object
Object IDs are not sequential/guessable in a way that trivializes enumeration
Nested/related resources (e.g. /users/1/orders/2) enforce ownership on BOTH ids
Response does not include fields the caller shouldn't see (mass assignment on read)
Write endpoints reject client-supplied privileged fields (role, isAdmin, price, ownerId)
Endpoint enforces a rate limit per account/IP on sensitive actions
Pagination/list endpoints cap page size (no unbounded export)
Low-privilege account cannot call admin/staff-only endpoints
HTTP method tampering (GET-only endpoint tried with PUT/DELETE) does not bypass auth
Workflow steps cannot be skipped or replayed out of order (e.g. pay after ship)
Negative quantities / negative prices / currency downgrade are rejected server-side
URL-accepting parameters (webhooks, image fetch, import-by-URL) block internal/metadata IPs
Verbose stack traces / debug mode disabled in production responses
CORS does not reflect arbitrary Origin with credentials allowed
Security headers present (HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, CSP as applicable)
Old/deprecated API versions are not still reachable without the same controls
Non-production/staging hosts are not silently in scope and are not weaker than prod
Input is validated/escaped server-side, not just client-side
Data pulled from third-party/upstream APIs is treated as untrusted before use
